title: Book One · Chapter 22: Rain
story:
Ronan is eating breakfast. Rain begins outside. He hears it against the window. Then it rains harder. Mrs Lan calls from the front room. Is the washing still outside?

Mum runs out. Dad helps bring in the shirts. Ronan holds the door. One wet sleeve slaps his face.

"Your washing hit me," he says.

"It doesn't like coming in early," Mum says.

The kite paper covers half the table. The dry clothes need the other half. Mum asks Ronan to clear his things into the room.

He puts the first kite on the low shelf. He leans it against the wall. The red-sail book stays flat beneath it. Jun's paper shape goes on the board under the table. He puts two clean sheets beside it.

Dad looks at the yard. There is a puddle near the gate. The tap is closed. It is not dripping. The rain runs down from the roof.

"No flying today," he says.

"The wind is good," Ronan says.

"The paper isn't a duck."

At school, the playground stays empty. Water runs along the path outside the classroom. Water drips inside near the door. Miss Wu puts a bucket under it. Then she sends a note to the school office.

The children must stay in for break. The room becomes loud. Leo tries to draw a very large kite but keeps putting his elbow over Ronan's paper.

Mei asks them to stop shaking the desk behind hers. She is painting a row of houses. The wet blue on one roof has run into the wall.

"You can make it rain," Leo suggests.

"I don't want it to rain in my picture."

She turns back to her work. Ronan looks at the wet paint. Mei did not want that blue wall. He does not tell her to keep it.

Jun comes over. "Will mine be blue?"

"Part of the tail will be blue."

"Can you bring it tomorrow?"

Ronan looks toward the window. "The paper is wet now. I will try again another day."

He talks only about the rain. But he still needs to put the paper on the sticks. He does not tell Jun about that work.

After school, Mum holds the umbrella low. Ronan keeps his bag in front so the wet edge won't rub it. By the time they get home, his socks are damp.

Mum puts the umbrella by the door. Dad is out. He went to ask about work. The room smells of wet cloth and hot rice.

Ronan pulls the board from under the table. He can cut another shape while it rains. He measures the old folds. He uses his school scissors slowly.

Then Mum needs the table for a shirt. The customer needs it that evening. Ronan puts the paper back under the table.

"Move it farther from the door," she says. "Water may come under that side of the kitchen door."

He pulls the board closer to the wall. A tiny dark patch lies near one corner. He touches it. The ground feels cool. But is it wet? He is not sure.

He means to check again after dinner. Then Dad returns with a bent umbrella, and they all laugh while he tries to close it.

By bedtime, the board is hidden under a chair. The room is finally dry and full. Ronan listens to the rain. He wants a dry day to fly. He keeps thinking about that. He does not check the paper again.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：rain＝雨；dry＝干的；damp＝微湿的；drips＝滴水。

理解问题：

1. 下雨怎样改变了试飞安排？
2. Ronan 为了腾桌子，把纸移到了哪里？
